title: diagnostics.list output
description: The Error List rows, in Error List order.

path.description: File path relative to the workspace root, with forward slashes.

project.description: Name of the project the file belongs to, as Workspace shows it; omitted when the file is in no loaded project.

source.description: Where the row comes from, as the Error List's Build + IntelliSense filter names it: build (the last build only), live (the language server or the solution load only), both (the build reported the same file, position and code as a live diagnostic, so the row is shown once), or test (a test that failed in the last test run, at its failure's first stack frame in the project; brief 0035). or nuget (the last NuGet restore of the project, at its project file; brief 0048). Omitted means live.
